generate_image_from_prompt: generate an image from a text prompt using the PixArtAlphaPipeline with classifier-free guidance
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into T5 text embeddings and attention masks for image generation
clean_caption_text: clean and normalize a caption string by removing URLs, HTML, special characters, and artifacts
prepare_noise_latents: prepare initial random noise latents scaled by the scheduler sigma for a given batch size and shape
retrieve_scheduler_timesteps: retrieve the timestep schedule from a diffusion scheduler given custom timesteps, sigmas, or inference steps
